 Govindpuri.
Mr. Kartik Rai, Mr. Sukrit Gupt  Akansha Rai and Mr. Rohit Kumar  Advs. for R-2.
CORAM:
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE VIKAS MAHAJAN  ORDER % 24.12.2025 1.

The present petition has been filed by the petitioner under Section 482 BNSS read with Section 438 Cr.P.C. seeking anticipatory bail in connection with FIR No. 500/2025, under Section 376/506 IPC registered at PS Govind Puri.
2. The allegations raised in the FIR pertain to the petitioner establishing sexual relationships with the prosecutrix on the pretext of false promise to marry.
3. Mr. Gurpreet Singh, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the parties were in a consensual relationship and had resided together in Nagpur for almost one year.

4. Mr. Kartik Rai, learned counsel for respondent no.2/prosecutrix controvert the submission of Mr.
Singh.
He submits that the prosecutrix This is a digitally signed order.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 24/12/2025 at 21:02:04 resided with the petitioner only for a period of 02 months.

5. However, Mr. Ajay Vikram Singh, learned APP, on being queried by the Court, on instructions from the I.O, states that the petitioner and the prosecutrix resided together in Nagpur for a period of one year.
6.

Mr. Gurpreet Singh further contends that the petitioner was also granted interim protection by Honey Kumar Sharma vs State Through Sho Ps Govind Puri & Anr on 24 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/74543009/

sentences.text: the learned Trial Court.
7. At this stage, Mr. Rai, submits that there is every possibility that the petitioner may flee from justice since he has obtained a Schengen Visa for his travel to Amsterdam.

8. In response, Mr. Singh states that the petitioner will immediately hand over his passport to the I.O.
9.
In view of the above, it is directed that no coercive action be taken against the petitioner subject to him joining the investigation.

10. On a query posed by the Court as to when the petitioner can be asked to join investigation,
learned APP, on instructions from the I.O submits that the petitioner can do so on 26.12.2025.
11. Let petitioner join investigation on 26.12.2025 at 4 PM, and subsequent thereto as and when asked by the IO concerned.
Further, let petitioner hand over his passport to the IO on 26.12.2025, as undertaken.
VIKAS MAHAJAN, J DECEMBER 24, 2025/
